desktop_prompt:
Generate ONE complete long DESKTOP website screen at 1280px width with actual HTML as a visual study of the CURRENT public Together AI homepage https://www.together.ai/ observed 2026-09-28. This is the 2026 white/mist-blue AI Native Cloud page, not a dark AI dashboard.

FIRST 1280×720 VIEWPORT: A very thin black promotional ticker at y0–40 with tiny white rotating announcement. At y~52 a floating white header strip x14–1266, h54: left colorful cluster glyph + black “together.ai”; center small nav Inference, Compute, Model Shaping, Research, Developers, Company, Pricing; right Contact sales and solid black Sign in. Hero background is a very light icy blue gradient. Left x42 y240 large two-line geometric sans title: black “Build what's next” and medium gray “on the AI Native Cloud”; font about 58–62px, tightly spaced. Under y390: “Full-stack AI platform, powered by cutting-edge research.” Under y435 rectangular black START BUILDING and pale gray CONTACT SALES buttons, small uppercase monospaced labels. Right half contains a distinctive official-style 3D diagram: translucent pale-blue circular disc, intersecting violet/purple orbital rings, blue oval blade, slanted orange hexagonal plate, and hairline annotations “OPTIMIZED TRAINING”, “PRODUCTION INFERENCE”, “CUTTING-EDGE RESEARCH”. Do not use a robot or generic SaaS dashboard in hero. Across y620 a very pale grey trusted-by brand-logo row.

Continue full-page in correct order with generous whitespace: centered “The Together AI Platform” and subtitle “Accelerate inference, model shaping and pre-training on a research-optimized platform.”; three equal pastel panels pale blue, pale pink and pale peach, respectively “FASTER INFERENCE 2x”, “LOWER COST 60%”, “FASTER PRE-TRAINING 90%” with short real supporting lines. After thin separators, centered “Full-stack cloud”, subtitle “Powering every step of the AI development journey—from experimentation to massive scale.”, wide three-tab strip Inference/Compute/Model shaping with pale cyan active Inference. Below that a white product showcase: on left a vertical list Serverless Inference, Batch Inference, Provisioned Throughput, Dedicated Model Inference, Dedicated Container Inference and explanatory text, on right a large realistic Together AI model/API interface screenshot style illustration. Then a deep midnight-navy section “Grounded in cutting-edge research” with first four actual research cards: “To Infinity and Beyond: ThunderKittens Now on NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72!”, “ThunderAgent: 2x Faster Agentic Inference for Synthetic Data Generation at Scale”, “Together AI at ICML 2026: frontier research across the full stack”, “ParallelKernelBench: Frontier LLMs can't write fast multi-GPU kernels (yet)”; tiny mono category labels and author lines; arrows and research-recognition logos. Next: centered “AI natives build on Together AI” and three mostly-black case-study cards for Cursor, Decagon and Vercept. Next: “What’s new at Together AI” asymmetric article grid, including The Open Source AI Stack, Migrating from closed to open source models, Together AI and Y Combinator GPU cluster, and GLM-5.3 vs Claude Fable 5. Final centered “Start building on Together AI” CTA and dense white footer with product/model/developer/resource columns and huge pale together.ai wordmark.

Style: exact brand-specific airy white page, subtle ice blue gradients, #050517 navy research area, black text, translucent blue/violet/orange 3D hero, geometric The Future-like sans, tiny uppercase mono labels, slim hairline separators, mostly square buttons/cards. Preserve observed wording and section order. Generate full HTML, no device frame, no invented pricing or model rankings.
mobile_prompt:
Generate ONE complete long MOBILE screen at 390px width with actual HTML as a visual study of the CURRENT public Together AI homepage https://www.together.ai/ observed 2026-09-28. Use this specific airy light 2026 design, not a generic dark AI product page.

FIRST 390×844 SCREEN: No desktop black promo ticker. Compact header on white/icy background x8–382 y8–68: colorful connected-circle together.ai glyph/wordmark at x20; solid black SIGN IN button at x244; pale gray square hamburger at x334. Hero background is extremely pale mist blue fading to white. Centered two/three-line geometric sans h1 starting y136: black “Build what's next” then gray “on the AI Native / Cloud” around 40px; support line at y282 “Full-stack AI platform, powered by cutting-edge research.” centered. Two square-corner CTAs centered around y340: black START BUILDING and pale gray CONTACT SALES with tiny monospaced labels. The desktop 3D illustration is hidden in the mobile first viewport; preserve the large blank/gradient breathing space until y535. Then a thin horizontally moving gray partner-logo strip around y570. At y690 starts centered black “The Together AI Platform” heading with a gray explanatory line and pastel metric cards beginning below y825. Cookie overlay is not part of the designed page.

Continue long mobile page in correct order: pale blue, pink, peach metric cards for Faster Inference 2x, Lower Cost 60%, Faster Pre-training 90%; centered Full-stack cloud heading and stack of Inference/Compute/Model shaping tabs; full-width product showcase with Serverless Inference and the other four product choices, realistic Together AI API interface preview below; midnight navy Grounded in cutting-edge research section with first four real research article cards; customer stories for Cursor, Decagon, Vercept as mostly-black cards; What’s new at Together AI article list; final centered Start building on Together AI CTA; white footer with stacked product/model/developer/resource links and very large pale together.ai wordmark. Include a mobile hamburger menu drawer with Inference, Compute, Model Shaping, Research, Developers, Company, Pricing.

Typography resembles The Future geometric sans and tiny PP Neue Montreal Mono labels; colors are white, very pale blue #eff7ff, cyan pastel, lavender and orange artwork, #050517 navy research, black CTAs. Generous whitespace and hairline rules. No fictional product claims, model rankings, pricing, fake robots, device frame or generic SaaS dashboard.
note: Native Stitch exports are preserved as separate design studies; public draft uses dated official source because generated screens invent statistics and imagery.
